title: 7.7. Pītittika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Napītisahagataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca napītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …pe….
Nasukhasahagataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …pe… naupekkhāsahagataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
